notes.title: 2023.5.1 Major game update, major changes to the overall game style and control
notes.notes:
This update has a lot of content, mainly for the huge changes in the game style and changes in the control method. Since the game was launched, we have received many comments and suggestions from players. We have made targeted changes to the game based on your concentrated opinions, mainly involving the following aspects:
1. The overall style of the game has been completely changed from a low-polygon style to a stylized cartoon style. Due to everyone's suggestions, we have almost remade the entire game. Of course, we think the visual changes are still obvious.
2. Added keyboard and mouse control. Everyone can happily use the keyboard and mouse to play games.
3. The control method of using the handle to play the game has been changed from controlling the front of the car to controlling the left and right steering to keep it consistent with most racing games on the market.
4. The gameplay is changed from unlocking vehicles and maps by missions to obtaining coins by missions, and then you can freely unlock your favorite maps and vehicles according to the coins.
5. Greatly optimized the performance of the game.
6. Adjusted the UI of the game to have a better gaming experience.
7. The support of DLC has been added, and there will be 4 advanced off-road DLCs to meet with you soon.
8. Adjusted the lighting, vegetation, fog and many other details in the game.

If you encounter any problems or have special suggestions, please contact us by email or other methods you know. We will thank you for valid questions or suggestions that are finally adopted, and you may be able to get our new game. Closed beta qualification or other games. Thank you very much, I wish you a happy game.

notes.title: 2022.06.14 Game Update Instructions
notes.notes:
1. Added world leaderboard, you can now see your ranking
2. Added the world challenge, you can choose the top 10 rankings in the world to challenge, if you get a high score, you can also enter the leaderboard
3. Added camera sensitivity adjustment
4. Added vehicle steering sensitivity adjustment
5. Increase the friction of the wheels, which can make cornering easier

6. Fixed the situation that some detection points would cause abnormal vehicles
7. Fixed a bug that some maps could enter underwater
8. Fixed the bug that rocks flying in the air in some maps
9. Fixed the bug that the drone flight could not be restarted in the free driving state
